subject.title: fix(line): AI-assisted - requireMention can now optionally gate non-text messages with bounded pending-media retention

question: Should LINE add these two opt-in settings and own bounded process-local media retention across separate webhook turns after eviction cleanup is fixed?
rationale: The feature changes public configuration, media ownership, delayed delivery, and same-group scheduling; code correctness cannot establish whether maintainers want that permanent channel contract.

options.title: Approve bounded retention
options.body: Repair eviction cleanup, document restart and TTL limits, and require live LINE proof before merge.

options.title: Gate without retention
options.body: Add only opt-in non-text mention gating and explicitly discard skipped media.

options.title: Keep current passthrough
options.body: Decline the new settings and continue processing non-text media when LINE supplies no mention metadata.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded retention
recommendation.body: Repair eviction cleanup, document restart and TTL limits, and require live LINE proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current LINE mention-gating contract and are the clearest history-backed owner for this extension decision.
